solutions.title: Recursive DFS
solutions.strategy: Visit node, recursively traverse left subtree, then recursively traverse right subtree.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every node in the tree is visited once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Call stack frames correspond to the height h of the tree.

solutions.title: Iterative stack
solutions.strategy: Use an explicit stack, popping the current node and pushing right before left to process left children first.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node is pushed and popped exactly once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The stack stores at most nodes along the branch depth.
